title: Skill Timing in CTB and ATB

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body:
It is said everywhere that CTB and ATB speeds are difficult to manage.  To make things worse, there is little information on the math being used by these systems or how they are affected by the speed of skills.  I think most players using these systems go with default settings and resort to play-testing to find balance.
In the game I'm designing, I started with an overall storyboard, and a list of likes and dislikes taken from other games, then put total focus into the combat system and skills.  For me, a game has to have great combat structure or I wont play it unless it has a crazy-good story or its unique and short.
My skills have ten speed levels for math balance they are approximately linear in terms of the time I wanted them to take to execute during play, but alas, RPG maker does not work that way.  I'm handling this using CTB (only to show the turn order), and the speed adjustments are:
0 +2000
1 +1500
2 +1000
3 +600
4 +300
5 +100
6  normal
7 -100
8 -200
9 -300
10 -400
11 -500
For default speed to CTB conversion I'm using ((SPEEDstat+100)/20)+5.  This pumps out at least 5 minimum, gives some cushion for modifiers, and keeps the standard output range between 10 and 40 as speed/agility stat grows from 1 to 600.
Does anyone have any tricks, techniques, or insight on timing in their games?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There's no such thing as "these systems" built into MZ - you must be talking about plugins, and how the numbers work would depend on the specific plugin.
So...which plugins are you using?
